command:
set -euo pipefail
PID=$(pgrep -fo '/opt/google/chrome/chrome --app=http://127.0.0.1:8788/' || true)
echo PID=$PID
echo '=== CMDLINE ==='
tr '\0' ' ' </proc/$PID/cmdline; echo
echo '=== SELECTED ENV ==='
tr '\0' '\n' </proc/$PID/environ | grep -E '^(DISPLAY|DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS|XDG_RUNTIME_DIR|XAUTHORITY|WAYLAND_DISPLAY|HOME|USER|LOGNAME|DESKTOP_SESSION|XDG_SESSION_TYPE)=' | sort || true
echo '=== LOCAL BRIDGE ENV ==='
env | grep -E '^(DISPLAY|DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS|XDG_RUNTIME_DIR|XAUTHORITY|WAYLAND_DISPLAY|HOME|USER|LOGNAME|DESKTOP_SESSION|XDG_SESSION_TYPE)=' | sort || true
echo '=== PROC STATUS ==='
grep -E '^(Name|State|PPid|Uid|Gid):' /proc/$PID/status || true
